items.statement: The company's domestic sales grew by 29.5% and exports grew by 28.6%, leading to a total sales volume growth of 29.3%.
The company's performance was negatively impacted by adverse commodity prices, foreign exchange movements, and unfavorable fixed cost incidence due to inventory depletion.
items.quote: Adverse commodity prices in the context of West Asia conflict Adverse foreign exchange movement Unfavourable Fixed Cost Incidence (FCI) on account of inventory depletion

items.statement: The company faced cost pressures from adverse commodity prices linked to the West Asia conflict and adverse foreign exchange movements.
items.quote: Adverse commodity prices in the context of West Asia conflict Adverse foreign exchange movement

items.statement: Depreciation expenses increased due to the capacity expansion at the Kharkhoda facility.
items.quote: Higher employee expense (Q1 seasonality) Higher depreciation expense (capacity expansion at Kharkhoda facility)

items.statement: Suzuki Motor Gujarat Private Limited was amalgamated with Maruti Suzuki India Limited starting December 1, 2025.
items.quote: Note: Suzuki Motor Gujarat Private Limited (SMG), a wholly owned subsidiary of Maruti Suzuki India Limited (MSIL), amalgamated with MSIL starting December 1, 2025.
